what_this_commits: The matched-pair reanalysis and required-T derivation for EXP-HQC-982268 (TASK-20260806-e120e8): design.md, matched_pair_reanalysis.py, reanalysis_results.json, reanalysis_report.md, run_manifest.yaml, and run logs. NO new (T)-sampling occurred: the pilot's own shards (5000, 6000) were deterministically regenerated via stage_a.py's real _t_shard with the pilot's own seeds and verified bit-identical to the pilot's own reported histograms (exact match, all 57 bins, both shards) before any new analysis was performed on them.
ordering: Committed and verified BEFORE either independent review task (TASK-20260806-f743ae validator, TASK-20260806-2cec38 red-team) is dispatched.
status_of_contents: OBSERVATIONS ONLY, per the executor's role. The matched-pair method was validated by first reproducing the Red Team's own probe shard (424242) numbers EXACTLY (533/5000 flips, k=17 diff +0.1922, power ratio 2.782x vs. their reported 2.78x) before applying it to the pilot's data. At k=17 (10,000 matched pairs): diff=+0.0516, SE=0.0966 (3.12x tighter than the pilot's original between-shard SE of 0.4437), z=+0.534 -- not significant. Across k=2..26, |z_paired| never exceeds 0.632; the power-ratio dose-response (10.0x at k=2 down to 1.76x at k=26) reproduces the Red Team's finding on the pilot's own data. THE REQUIRED-T DERIVATION IS THE DECISIVE NEW RESULT: using the Red Team's 10.7 percent local flip rate as the effect-size input, with an explicit power target (two-sided alpha=0.05, 90 percent power), and a closed-form structural result showing the estimator is DOUBLY DILUTED (by the k/n_e block-fraction AND by a marginal-rate invariance built into the estimator itself, which the executor derived and verified: Delta(log2_A_k) = (k/n_e)*Delta_p/ln2 * [mu_bar_{k-1}/mu_bar_k - 1/q_hat], whose bracket vanishes under i.i.d. blocks), the required T at k=17 is approximately 4.33e8 -- roughly 1,400x the frozen specification's own undefected T_req of 3.09e5. The executor also flagged, as a reliability caveat on this number, that none of the four independent Delta_p point estimates it computed (the Red Team's, its own, and per-shard) is itself statistically distinguishable from zero (McNemar |z| < 2 in every case).
ambiguity_resolution: GENUINELY AMBIGUOUS, stated plainly by the executor: neither a clear signal (|z| < 3 everywhere in the matched-pair reanalysis) nor a clear null (the achieved T=10,000 is roughly five orders of magnitude below the derived required T at k=17). No campaign-level recommendation (positive control vs. full run vs. something else) is offered here -- that is reserved for the Validator and Red Team.
claim_boundary: Toy. A reanalysis of already-collected pilot data plus a derived cost estimate; no new experiment was run. No statement about A17, HQC's decoding-failure rate, or any standardized parameter set. The required-T figure, if independently confirmed, has direct budget implications for whether ANY further real-sampler work on this specific defect class and injection point remains affordable at all.
